designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt created the Kaniksu National Forest from part of the Priest River National Forest in Idaho and Washington.
designationHistory.note: The executive order text was not located online. FS-612 and the 1944 WPA list of executive orders (compiled from the orders) agree on EO 845 of 1908-06-26; Davis gives the effective date, July 1, 1908.
